spec_gaps.density_feather_linked: STU-RAS-016: 'Masks MUST support density/opacity, feather, and enable/disable, and MUST be linkable or unlinkable from parent-layer position.' The clause sits with raster masks; Folio's StudioVectorMask (STU-VEC-053/153) had no home for them. Enrichment: name StudioVectorMaskParameters (density percent 0..=100 default 100, feather px 0..=10000 default 0, linked default true) as the vector-mask carrier of STU-RAS-016, and state that an unlinked mask stays in canvas/composition space (Photoshop-style).
spec_gaps.reveal_outside: STU-VEC-153 row 'mask_clip | boolean | -- | false' does not say what false means. Importers store SVG and Figma masks (zero outside the mask content) as false, which equals Illustrator's Clip ON (black background); Illustrator's Clip OFF (white background, outside revealed) then has no encoding. Enrichment: define mask_clip=false as the SVG/Figma reading and add reveal_outside (LUMINANCE only) for Illustrator Clip off, or redefine mask_clip with an importer migration. UNVERIFIED against Illustrator (D5).
spec_gaps.pass_through_mask: STU-VEC-153 / STU-VEC-025: groups default to blend.pass_through and isolate_blending is a separate control, but no clause defines a clip or mask on a pass-through group. Pigment now carries the W3C Compositing 1 s3.2 reading (a masked group is isolated, composited Normal) as a caller-chosen rule; enrichment: state that reading, or the Photoshop one once the D5 oracle measures it.
spec_gaps.rendered_sources: STU-VEC-053: 'Masking MUST be a shared Studio capability ([STU-DOC-004]) using the canonical StudioMask primitive, not a vector-only reimplementation.' The mask source may be any payload (Folio doc 'any payload'); enrichment: state that raster/text/image content masks are evaluated from the rendered source (straight RGBA of the source alone, its own appearance applied), as the caller-rendered route does.
